svg.title: Pumped thermal energy storage — Dæld varmaorkugeymsla
svg.desc: Two insulated thermal stores connect through a lower heat-pump and power-conversion unit, with a six-ray cold mark on the left and two rising heat curves on the right.
svg.metadata: {"collection":"UteamUP Sectors and Nature","subject":"power-pumped-thermal-storage","label_en":"Pumped thermal energy storage","label_is":"Dæld varmaorkugeymsla","section":"06","category_en":"Power plants and generation","category_is":"Orkuver og orkuframleiðsla","batch":3,"tags":["power","energy-storage"],"description":"Two insulated thermal stores connect through a lower heat-pump and power-conversion unit, with a six-ray cold mark on the left and two rising heat curves on the right.","design_note":"Separate warm and cool reservoirs with a conversion loop represent pumped thermal storage rather than electrical battery cells.","style":{"viewBox":[0,0,24,24],"stroke":"#1655A6","stroke_width":0.9,"fill":"none","background":"transparent"}}
